reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding*

*HIGH — `src/dedupe.js:2`: duplicates are compared by object identity, not contact ID.* `new Set(contacts)` keeps separate objects with the same `id`, so `mergeImports` fails on overlapping imports—the branch’s core feature and the contract in `README.md:5`.

Reproduced: merging `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada'}]` and `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada updated'}]` returns both contacts instead of just the first.

*Recommended fix:* track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add a regression test using distinct objects with the same ID, including across two import lists. The current test, `test/dedupe.test.js` → `the same object is not repeated`, only checks repeated references.

All 4 existing tests pass. No other findings; no files changed.
